title: [Day 02] Session format and event types
text:
@cursor Part 3 of 5 for issue #2: Runtime validation.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts, QA and bug fixes, Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #2, then do ONLY Part 3.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(shared): add runtime event validation (#2)` with tests and stubs, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Implement `parseEvent(input: unknown): Result<RewindEvent>`. Choose valibot or hand-written guards and explain the choice in your PR note.

Requirements:
- Never throws, for any input
- Returns a readable error path for invalid input
- Bundle impact noted in the PR note

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- One valid and at least one invalid test case for every event type
- A test that passes `null`, a number, a string and a random object without throwing

Implementation commit message: `feat(shared): add runtime event validation (#2)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" ...`

If you make a decision a reviewer might question (for example valibot vs hand-written guards, or the shape of `Result`), add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and list it in docs/decisions/README.md.

Push to the existing branch `day-02/session-format`. Do not open a new PR. Do n
